# AiBhive — full LLM corpus
# https://aibhive.com/llms-full.txt
# Companion to https://aibhive.com/llms.txt — curated page summaries for AI agents.

> AiBhive is an AI app factory and agentic automation platform. Build apps in plain English (Bhive Builder), install community tools (Hive Apps), research with archive scraping/OCR/translation (Research Lab), and deploy enterprise multi-agent workflows.

## What is AiBhive?

AiBhive helps individuals and businesses ship software and automation without traditional development cycles. Three public product surfaces matter most:

1. **Bhive Builder / App hub** (`/app`, `/hive-apps/build`) — describe a mobile app, web app, site, or dashboard in plain English; the builder delivers a working app. Bring your own API keys (BYOK) or use Hive credits.
2. **Hive Apps** (`/hive-apps`) — a community pool of installable tools. Try demos, install free apps, tweak existing ones, or commission custom builds from a few dollars.
3. **Research Lab** (`/research-lab`) — community-sourced research: Fable Scrape for stealth archive harvesting, OCR Lab for batch image-to-text, translation (including historical scripts), and a shared discovery library.

Enterprise customers also deploy **agentic workflows** for real estate (listings, missed-call text-back, CRM), lead generation, customer ops, document/ERP processing, phone/SMS, and regulated medical/legal transcription.

## Home — https://aibhive.com/

AiBhive positions as an AI app factory plus agentic automation platform. Primary offers: build apps without coding, browse Hive Apps, run Research Lab tools, and book enterprise strategy for multi-agent operations. Best for founders, agents, operators, and creators who want production tools fast.

## App hub — https://aibhive.com/app

Command center for Bhive Builder on web. Users build mobile apps, web apps, and sites; explore topic hubs (automated social, phone intelligence, lead generation, productivity, research); and manage Hive credits. Same builder model as the Android app.

## Build a Hive App — https://aibhive.com/hive-apps/build

Guided flow: describe the app in plain English, review a quote, approve, and Bhive Builder constructs it in the browser. Designed for non-developers and power users who want custom tools without writing code.

## Hive Apps store — https://aibhive.com/hive-apps

Community storefront. First apps are inexpensive ($1–$5 range messaging). Users browse store listings, try web runners, install free community apps, and share improvements. Demo runners include resume bot, research/OSINT, job hunter, social post hunter, and a mock real estate dashboard.

## Research Lab — https://aibhive.com/research-lab

Landing for AiBhive’s community research suite. Users scrape archives (including sites that block naive bots via Fable Scrape), run OCR, translate texts (modern and historical scripts), ask smart questions over a RAG library, and share findings. Workspace tools require sign-in (`/research-lab/workspace` — not for indexing of private sessions).

## Fable Scrape — https://aibhive.com/fable-scrape

AI research harvester: tell agents what to find; they crawl with stealth engines, filter content, route through residential proxies when needed, OCR documents, translate with user-chosen models, and publish into a communal library. Guide: https://aibhive.com/fable-scrape/guide

## OCR Lab — https://aibhive.com/ocr-lab

Batch vision OCR: upload up to ~100 photos and export formatted text, Markdown, or PDF. Built for archives, scanned books, handwritten notes, and research images.

## Real estate AI tools — https://aibhive.com/tools/real-estate-ai

Intent-mapped guide for agents, investors, and property managers covering:

- Listing description writers (MLS-ready copy)
- Real estate video / content AI
- CRM & lead automation
- Missed-call text-back
- Property management dashboards

Enterprise depth: https://aibhive.com/solutions/real-estate-ai-automation

## Transcription Studio — https://aibhive.com/transcription

Multi-agent transcription for general, legal, and medical audio. Specialized agents cross-check acoustic, linguistic, and domain jargon claims to target higher accuracy than single-model STT. Related use cases: podcasters, YouTubers, legal, medical.

## Voice Clone Lab — https://aibhive.com/voice-clone

Neural voice cloning for creators and businesses. Preserve tone and emotion across 10+ languages for dubbed content and localized growth. Tied to Grow Globally ROI narrative (`/grow`).

## Crawl policy notes

Public marketing and product guide pages allow major search and AI crawlers (see robots.txt). Disallowed: `/homework`, `/admin`, `/test`, `/hive-apps/embed`, `/app/settings`, `/research-lab/workspace`.
